rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for the cardinal number 1.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dak1 jat1 zoeng1 fei1 zaa3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose numeral for saying that there is a single item, normally followed by the appropriate classifier and noun.

example.english: I bought one bottle of water.
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 zi1 seoi2

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for one member of a larger group.

example.english: Among these books, one is my favorite.
example.traditional: 呢幾本書入面，其中一個係我最鍾意。
example.jyutping: ni1 gei2 bun2 syu1 jap6 min6 kei4 zung1 jat1 go3 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3

rows.note: Use this for a person in general when English uses impersonal “one.”

example.english: One should not only think about oneself.
example.traditional: 人唔應該淨係顧住自己。
example.jyutping: jan4 m4 jing1 goi1 zing6 hai6 gu3 zyu6 zi6 gei2

rows.jyutping: jat1 go3 A ling6 jat1 go3 B
rows.note: Use this contrastive pattern when referring to the first of two things or people and then contrasting it with the other.

example.english: One wants tea, and the other wants coffee.
example.traditional: 一個要飲茶，另一個要飲咖啡。
example.jyutping: jat1 go3 jiu3 jam2 caa4 ling6 jat1 go3 jiu3 jam2 gaa3 fe1
